mapper.sql: select fee_id feeId,project_id projectId,recipient_user_id recipientUserId,recipient_user_name recipientUserName, calculation_mode calculationMode,fixed_amount fixedAmount,profit_rate profitRate, currency,status,config_reason configReason,configured_user_id configuredUserId, configured_user_name configuredUserName,configured_time configuredTime, eligibility_project_count eligibilityProjectCount,eligibility_project_ids eligibilityProjectIds, eligibility_project_names eligibilityProjectNames,eligibility_checked_time eligibilityCheckedTime, basis_revenue basisRevenue, basis_business_cost basisBusinessCost,basis_personnel_cost basisPersonnelCost,basis_bonus_cost basisBonusCost, basis_adjustment basisAdjustment,pre_fee_profit preFeeProfit,settled_amount settledAmount, accounting_fact_id accountingFactId,settled_user_id settledUserId,settled_user_name settledUserName, settled_time settledTime,version,create_time createTime,update_time updateTime from biz_project_management_fee where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when f.fact_kind='REVENUE' then f.amount else 0 end),0) basisRevenue, coalesce(sum(case when f.fact_kind='COST' and f.category_code not in('PROJECT_BONUS_COST','PROJECT_MANAGEMENT_FEE') then f.amount else 0 end),0) basisBusinessCost, coalesce(sum(case when f.fact_kind='COST' and f.category_code='PROJECT_BONUS_COST' then f.amount else 0 end),0) basisBonusCost, coalesce(sum(case when f.fact_kind='ADJUSTMENT' then f.amount else 0 end),0) basisAdjustment, coalesce((select sum(r.personnel_cost) from biz_project_daily_result r where r.project_id=#{projectId} and r.is_current='1'),0) basisPersonnelCost from biz_operating_fact f where f.project_id=#{projectId} and f.status in('CONFIRMED','REVERSED')
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_management_fee(project_id,recipient_user_id,recipient_user_name,calculation_mode, fixed_amount,profit_rate,minimum_profit,cap_amount,currency,status,config_reason,configured_user_id, configured_user_name,configured_time,eligibility_project_count,eligibility_project_ids, eligibility_project_names,eligibility_checked_time,version,create_time,update_time) values(#{projectId},#{recipientUserId},#{recipientUserName},#{calculationMode},#{fixedAmount},#{profitRate}, 0,null,#{currency},#{status},#{configReason},#{userId},#{userName},sysdate(), #{eligibilityProjectCount},#{eligibilityProjectIds},#{eligibilityProjectNames},sysdate(),0,sysdate(),sysdate()) on duplicate key update recipient_user_id=values(recipient_user_id),recipient_user_name=values(recipient_user_name), calculation_mode=values(calculation_mode),fixed_amount=values(fixed_amount),profit_rate=values(profit_rate), minimum_profit=0,cap_amount=null,currency=values(currency),status=values(status), config_reason=values(config_reason),configured_user_id=values(configured_user_id), configured_user_name=values(configured_user_name),configured_time=sysdate(), eligibility_project_count=values(eligibility_project_count),eligibility_project_ids=values(eligibility_project_ids), eligibility_project_names=values(eligibility_project_names),eligibility_checked_time=sysdate(), version=version+1,update_time=sysdate()
mapper.update: update biz_project_management_fee set status='SETTLED',basis_revenue=#{basisRevenue}, basis_business_cost=#{basisBusinessCost},basis_personnel_cost=#{basisPersonnelCost},basis_bonus_cost=#{basisBonusCost}, basis_adjustment=#{basisAdjustment},pre_fee_profit=#{preFeeProfit},settled_amount=#{settledAmount}, accounting_fact_id=#{accountingFactId},settled_user_id=#{userId},settled_user_name=#{userName}, settled_time=sysdate(),version=version+1,update_time=sysdate() where project_id=#{projectId} and status in('CONFIGURED','WAIVED')
mapper.select: select payment_id paymentId,fee_id feeId,project_id projectId,amount,paid_date paidDate,method, reference_no referenceNo,voucher,reason,request_key requestKey,recorded_user_id recordedUserId, recorded_user_name recordedUserName,create_time createTime from biz_project_management_fee_payment where fee_id=#{feeId} order by paid_date desc,payment_id desc

select payment_id paymentId,fee_id feeId,project_id projectId,amount,paid_date paidDate,method, reference_no referenceNo,voucher,reason,request_key requestKey from biz_project_management_fee_payment where project_id=#{projectId} and request_key=#{requestKey} limit 1
